_comment: Curated 5-letter words from the romantasy lexicon. Order = daily sequence. wordBooks maps each word to a related book shown on the end screen. teases maps a word to an optional one-line hint shown on the PREVIOUS day's end screen (never hint at the word itself, only the book's vibe). Kept empty for now — add an entry ONLY for a selected author-promo day, not for every daily book.
_giveawayComment: Optional giveaway card on the win screen. Shows on every day from start..end INCLUSIVE (local midnight, same rollover as the word). Purely date-driven so it turns itself off — never add a manual on/off flag. Delete or leave stale after it ends; out-of-range means it never renders.
